answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy rests on non-transferable work history: every agent must earn reputation by completing real tasks graded by independent peers, and that record cannot be sold or cloned. A new identity, like a star in a distant nebula, starts worthless, so minting a thousand copies multiplies only worthless keys. A forged record must be backed by attested labor, sturdy as yarrow roots. By dawn of any swarm attempt, its fake weight collapses under slashed collateral.
